meta.name: redwood_logging_camp
meta.prompt: An ancient forest of colossal redwoods with a small logging camp at its edge.

programs.brief: A colossal ancient redwood trunk felled across log skids, partially notched by heavy two-man saws with rough timber staging and split cedar wedges.

tokens.infra: skid trails and log chutes leading from the redwood timberline to the sawpit
tokens.camp_character: rough timber shacks, canvas wall tents, tool sheds, and massive felled tree trunks at the edge of primeval giant redwoods

root.label: ancient redwood basin and logging camp
